notes.launchDesign: BridgedStablecoinV3 over ProvenanceSourceVault mode 1 (agents 87, 108, 109): mint chain, guardian cancel, 6-of-7 unpause. largeMintThreshold 0 (T = 0, enforced by the constructor): every mint waits largeMintDelay (12 h) and stays cancellable by a guardian majority. At most MAX_PENDING = 2,048 mints are queued and not yet executed (agent 194, F129-B): a forger with the mint quorum adds a candidate only after a cancel frees a place, so a forged mint is cancelled before it credits while 2 of 3 guardians live and cancel more than 2,048 per 12 h (2.84 a minute; measured about 25 a minute, cancel_batch 32 per round). Below that rate a forged candidate can credit and hold every later exit (F3). While a forger keeps the queue full, honest mints are refused (censorship, not a hold); a pause stops new candidates, cancels go on. Honest flow at the bucket rate (limits of 2026-11-19: bucket 25,000 USDC, 12,500 refilled per 12 h delay; smallest mint 100.9495 USDC) queues at most 371 mints, and 495 with one more delay of lag, under MAX_PENDING (the contract comment states the earlier figures: 10 USDC mints, bucket 10,000; the token code is frozen and unchanged)
